title: Sales Ledger Administrator
description:
Sewell Wallis is currently recruiting for a Sales Ledger Administrator to join the finance team of an established and growing business based in Penistone, South Yorkshire.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with previous transactional finance experience who enjoys working in a busy, varied and hands-on environment. The role will primarily focus on sales ledger administration, invoicing and credit control for a dedicated portfolio of repeat customers, alongside providing occasional holiday and absence cover for the weighbridge function.

The position is initially offered on a 12-month temporary contract, with a genuine opportunity for the role to become permanent for the right person.

What will you be doing?
- Managing the day-to-day administration of your own portfolio of repeat customers.
- Checking daily driver paperwork, round sheets and movement tickets against cash collected, ensuring all information is complete and accurate.
- Investigating discrepancies and missing information, liaising with drivers and operational colleagues to resolve queries.
- Preparing and raising weekly and monthly sales invoices.
- Monitoring cash collections and allocating customer receipts to the correct accounts.
- Supporting credit control activities, including issuing statements and investigating outstanding balances.
- Responding to customer account queries and providing copies of invoices and supporting documentation where required.
- Maintaining accurate customer account records and ensuring transactions are processed promptly.
- Providing holiday and absence cover for the weighbridge operation, typically around four weeks per year, with additional cover when required.
- Registering incoming and outgoing vehicles, processing driver paperwork and accurately entering information into the weighbridge system.

What skills are we looking for?
- Previous experience in sales ledger, accounts receivable, credit control, invoicing or a similar transactional finance administration role.
- Excellent attention to detail, with the ability to identify missing or inconsistent information.
- Good organisational skills and the ability to manage recurring daily, weekly and monthly tasks.
- Comfortable working with paperwork, cash records and computer-based systems.
- Good Microsoft Excel skills.
- Experience using Sage 200 would be advantageous.
- Confident communication skills, with the ability to liaise with drivers, colleagues and occasionally customers.
- A proactive approach to investigating queries and resolving issues.
- The ability to work accurately and efficiently in a busy environment.
- A flexible approach and willingness to provide support across different areas of the business.

Formal finance qualifications are not required; practical experience, accuracy and the right attitude are more important.

What's on offer?
- Salary of £28,000 £30,000 per annum.
- Initial 12-month temporary contract, with the potential to become permanent.
- Monday to Friday working hours, 8:30am 5:00pm.
- Paid half-hour lunch break.
- Company pension scheme.
- Access to an employee discounts app.
- Free on-site parking.
- Full training and ongoing support from an experienced finance team.
- A varied role offering exposure to both finance administration and weighbridge operations.
- The opportunity to join an established and growing business with long-term career potential.

Please note: Due to the rural location of the site and limited public transport links, you must hold a full driving licence and have access to your own vehicle. This is a fully office-based position, Monday to Friday.

For more information, contact Inci or apply below.

title: Accounts Payable and Receivable Officer
description:
Sewell Wallis is currently working with a fast-paced South Yorkshire retail business that is now looking for an Accounts Payable and Receivable Officer to join their finance team in Barnsley. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment, takes pride in getting the detail right and is confident managing a varied transactional finance workload.

You'll play an important role in supporting the day-to-day finance function, taking ownership of Accounts Payable and Receivable, while also having the chance to be involved in month-end processes and financial reporting.

What will you be doing?

- Obtaining and reconciling monthly supplier statements, investigating disputed invoices and liaising with suppliers to resolve queries.
- Reviewing and monitoring purchase orders and setting up new supplier accounts, ensuring bank details are verified in line with company procedures.

- Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including the confident use of SUMIFS and XLOOKUP and/or VLOOKUP.

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Bookkeeper

Rotherham £28,000 £30,000 FTE Full-Time or Part-Time Flexible 3 5 Days

V-Recruit are working in partnership with an established construction contractor operating within the public sector, who are looking to bring their bookkeeping function in-house by recruiting an experienced Bookkeeper to join their team.

This is an excellent opportunity for an organised and detail-oriented finance professional to take ownership of day-to-day bookkeeping activities, supporting the smooth running of the company's financial operations.

The position is based in Rotherham, with flexibility to accommodate either full-time or part-time working arrangements, offering between 3 5 days per week.

The Role

Working closely with the wider team, your responsibilities will include:
- Processing purchase invoices received through Dext and checking extracted information for accuracy and completeness before publishing to QuickBooks.
- Ensuring all relevant invoice details, including class allocations, are correctly recorded.
- Matching purchase invoices against expense transactions within QuickBooks.
- Allocating and coding additional bank transactions accurately.
- Reconciling the factoring account monthly against E-Capital statements and liaising directly with E-Capital regarding any discrepancies.
- Reconciling purchase ledgers against supplier statements and investigating any differences.
- Communicating directly with suppliers to resolve invoice and ledger queries.
- Reviewing CIS submissions, identifying and correcting errors, and confirming balances payable.
- Raising monthly VAT queries to obtain any outstanding information.
- Reconciling company bank accounts and credit cards.
- Preparing and finalising VAT returns, reviewing error reports and ensuring VAT has been correctly recorded and claimed.
- Posting payroll journals.
- Allocating payroll costs against the relevant projects based on employees' monthly working arrangements.

About You

To be considered for this position, you will ideally have:
- Previous experience in a similar Bookkeeper or Accounts role.
- Essential experience using QuickBooks.
- Experience using Dext would be advantageous.
- A good understanding of purchase ledger, bank and credit card reconciliations.
- Knowledge of VAT returns and CIS processes.
- Experience with payroll journals and cost allocations.
- Excellent attention to detail and the ability to investigate and resolve discrepancies.
- The ability to work independently, manage workloads and meet deadlines.

Job Specifics
- Salary of £28,000 £30,000 per annum (full-time equivalent).
- Freelance or self-employed basis candidates looking for a flexible contract arrangement will also be considered.
- Full-time or part-time hours available, with 3 5 days per week considered.
- Working hours of 8:00am 4:00pm.
- Office-based position in Rotherham.
- The opportunity to take ownership of an in-house bookkeeping function.
- The chance to become a valued member of an established construction business.

How to apply
